title: equisetum alpinum
intro: Equisetum alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Horse Tail, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Equisetaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which are beneficial in treating conditions such as arthritis, asthma, and urinary issues. The health benefits of Equisetum alpinum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and support the urinary system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as relaxing muscles, reducing fever, and promoting diuresis.
